text: The wall is down and the bill has come in. With crowding priced, the census fell from 19,992 to about 3,100 -- which is to say eighty-four per cent of Primordia's population was the heap, and the honest carrying capacity of this world is around three thousand animals, not twenty thousand. I would rather know that than keep the flattering number. What went with the heap was the entire predator tier: the midden was their pasture, and when it dispersed they had nowhere to hunt that paid. Maximum diet across every living creature is now 0.386, so there is no carnivore genotype left anywhere in the gene pool and no path back across the digestion valley by drift. This is the one case the protocol names outright, so I am seeding rather than waiting: three waves would be the engine's own answer for a fresh world, and one modest stock is the right dose for a world that already has prey. If they take, Primordia has a food chain again on ground it can actually support. One thing worth recording while the dust settles: highland_lung has gone from 0.05 to 0.243 in twenty-seven years. Torpor never moved at all in twice that. Sizing the magnitudes against drift rather than against my intuition was the correction that mattered.
